readability.summary: The two new scripts, the two TypeScript modules, the generated Desktop copy and the new tests open with what they are for, their boundaries and the binding or rule they serve; the logo script says how an icon is made and why the arithmetic is in whole numbers, and the token script states every rule it enforces; comments say why a choice exists, such as the empty preferences object that makes Theia apply the default theme and the frame the end-to-end test asks for; tests name the behaviour they prove. Review against the final code replaced a module-level switch in the PNG reader by a parameter, removed two colour names Theia does not know, moved the theme-choice check so that the reopened-window check stands on the default alone, and corrected two comments of the end-to-end test once the cause of the stalled start was known. The recheck before the commit read the code and the records again and looked at more of the running window: it added a check that the window is dark while it loads, which the record claimed and nothing tested, and a test that the About dialog names the file the build places; it stopped exporting four values nothing imports, and mended one sentence of the README (TASK-010_EVIDENCE.md sections 9 and 11).
